description: The line plot illustrates the relative change for different configurations of token counts and bit precisions across varying model layer groups. The categorical x-axis represents layer groupings with ticks labeled sequentially as "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32". The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" and uses a linear scale ranging from -15% to 5%, with grid lines and tick marks spaced at 5% intervals. A grey dashed line without markers represents the "Baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit," which remains constant at exactly 0% across all x-axis categories. A yellow solid line with circle markers represents "LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit," which begins near 0% at Layer1-4, exhibits a slight dip to approximately -1% at Layer5-12, returns to 0% at Layer13-20, dips slightly to -0.5% at Layer21-28, and concludes at a peak of roughly 0.5% at Layer29-32. A coral-red solid line with square markers denotes "LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit," starting slightly above 0% at Layer1-4, declining to approximately -2.5% at Layer5-12, maintaining a stable trend near -2% through Layer13-20 and Layer21-28, and rising to end at approximately -0.2% at Layer29-32. A light blue solid line with circle markers represents "RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit," beginning around -0.5% at Layer1-4, declining to roughly -2.5% at Layer5-12, reaching its lowest point of approximately -6% at Layer13-20, and then rising to roughly -4% at Layer21-28 before ending at approximately -1% at Layer29-32. Finally, a dark blue solid line with square markers indicates "RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit," which begins at approximately -1% at Layer1-4, drops to -5.5% at Layer5-12, experiences a steep decline to its minimum value of -14.5% at Layer13-20, and then steadily increases to -11% at Layer21-28, finishing at approximately -1.5% at Layer29-32.
